properties.description: The wire-level class gate for the bare-zero defect: starts the built binary on an EMPTY store, calls every no-argument read-only tool by name from `tools/list` — so a new tool joins the class the moment it is served — and fails if a reply whose count/items/value is empty carries neither `empty_because` nor the loop-debt `loop_hint`. Checked on the wire rather than in-process because the obligation is about what a consumer receives. Measured before the fix: 39 no-arg read-only tools, 10 empty on an empty design, 1 speaking, 9 bare. Runs in CI's workspace job after smoke_mcp and is listed in AGENTS.md's everyday gate block.
properties.name: empty_speaks.py
